alt: AI-generated fictional fashion scene of four adult women on cushioned wooden seating beside turquoise water and pastel houses. A blonde woman in a cropped Panama flag outfit hugs a seated braided woman in a turquoise beaded mini from behind. The seated woman clasps hands with a woman in a pearl cropped top and blue mini skirt, while a fourth leans in wearing another flag outfit. Rainbow legwear, varied boots and heels, and shell, heart-wave and RAZE tattoos appear. Distant smoke and mushroom-shaped clouds are invented scenery, not a real disaster.
